title: The Night God Set His People Free
reflectionQuestion: God's people waited a long, long time, but God never forgot them — and at just the right moment, he set them free. What is something good that you are waiting and hoping for?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (The First Passover, Exodus 12). Mood=grateful; God rescues + frees his people. WATCH: hard content handled by SUBTRACTION -- the firstborn night is told only as 'God passed over and kept his people safe'; no death, no plague detail (Joseph-method). Focus on rescue / freedom / remembering. Indelible image: the family eating standing up, sandals on, ready to run; the long line walking out free. Voice TBC at audio (proposed VOICE_REVEREND_MICHAEL_C_VINCENT).

scriptureKeyVerse.text: That same day, Yahweh brought the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt by their armies.
